name: reachinbox-scheduler-root
description: ReachInbox — Production-Grade Full-Stack Email Job Scheduler

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "SERVICES,API,WEB,WORKER" -c "cyan,blue,magenta,green" "npm run services:start" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web" "npm run worker"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=apps/api && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=apps/api && npm run test --workspace=apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=apps/api && npm run lint --workspace=apps/web
